reviews.text: Dealing with construction projects and remodels can be painful and frustrating but Joe and the crew at CREEKSIDE conduct themselves with a level of professionalism not common in the industry. I would trust them again on future projects and recommend them to family and friends!

reviews.text: Replacing part of a shower wall with glass really made the space appear larger. Creekside did not question such a small job. The person that did the estimate, and the installers were experienced and friendly. VERY happy!
reviews.author: A Parker

reviews.text: Outstanding company to work with. Outstanding craftsmanship. Outstanding customer service. Friendly staff, well knowledged in their products & services. Overall, I would highly recommend them and would use them again in a heartbeat. Thank you Creekside for a great experience!

reviews.text: Worked with em for years. Aaron and Richard are the best.

data.summary: The available reviews appear authentic in content, with specific details and varied writing styles. However, the extremely low volume of reviews (12 on Google, none elsewhere) and the perfect 5.0 rating with no critical feedback are unusual and warrant caution. There is no evidence of manipulation, but the sample size is too small to be statistically reliable.
fake_signals: Multiple Google reviews with minimal/no text content
Perfect 5.0 rating with no negative feedback
authentic_signals: Specific project details mentioned (shower wall replacement)
Specific employee names referenced (Joe, Aaron, Richard)
Mention of unique circumstance (open during COVID-19)
Varied writing styles and timeframes (reviews span 5 years)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Insufficient data across platforms to detect meaningful discrepancies. Google shows a perfect 5.0, but with low volume. BBB is not rated. No other platforms have review data.
